Name: Vampire Farming
Author: JackR0
Description:
[b][color=#a61c00]Vampire Farming by Jack Rivers[/color][/b]

﻿﻿"Vampires are slowly making their way to the valley, but first, they need to make sure their produce grows in Pelican Town soil. Dive into this small preview of the vampire life with these new crops!"

[color=#a61c00][b]---------------------------------------[/b][/color]

The next addition to the vampire series: crops!

This mod adds:

[list]
[*][b]7 New Crops[/b]
[*][b]1 New Fruit Tree[/b] - You have to grow it to see what it produces!
[*][b]5 New Artisan Goods[/b]
[*][b]5 New Cooking Recipes﻿[/b]
[/list]
[color=#a61c00][b]---------------------------------------[/b][/color]

[b]Notes: [/b]

[list]
[*][i]Specific[/i] villagers take a liking to these new items. This may or may not be a hint at an idea I have in the future.
[*] ﻿Some of the crops are the same/similar shapes as vanilla ones; this is on purpose! I wanted them to sort of be variants of the crops we already know and love, but just a little different or [i]unusual[/i]. 
[/list] ﻿ ﻿Everything is hand-drawn by me except for the fruit tree. (Recolored the sprite of the pomegranate tree) I didn't want to risk straying too far from the vanilla style.
﻿ ﻿I have more I want to add to this mod in the future, so this will act as a base! (I also just want to take a break and actually [i]play[/i] the game before I continue working on town buildings lmao.)

- As always, let me know about issues, bugs, etc, even ideas you have, and I might add them! <3

[b][color=#a61c00]---------------------------------------[/color][/b]
